chunks: What the Shaykh—may Allah Most High support him—informed me of, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from al-'Abbas, from al-Sakuni, from Ja'far, from his father عليهما السلام, from Abi Dharr, may Allah be pleased with him: “He came to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and said:
O Messenger of Allah, I am ruined; I had intercourse while there was no water.
He said: So the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم ordered for a litter-covering, and I concealed myself with it, and he called for water, so I performed ghusl, I and she.
Then he said: “O Aba Dharr, the earth suffices you for ten years.”

key_terms.بِمَحْمِلٍ: with a litter-covering or cloth used for concealment
key_terms.جَامَعْتُ: I had sexual intercourse, causing a state requiring ghusl
key_terms.عَشْرَ سِنِينَ: ten years, indicating extended sufficiency when water is unavailable

ai.seo_question: What should a person do for ritual purification after janabah when no water is available?
ai.summary: This hadith relates an incident in which a man informed the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم that he had entered a state requiring ghusl while lacking water. The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم then taught that clean earth serves as a sufficient substitute through tayammum when water is unavailable, indicating the facilitation built into the laws of ritual purity.
